C1.worst_defect: The hero 'Point of sale for Vendure' is clear and honest ('Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0', 'Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first'). But nothing tells a shop owner what they do on day one versus what their freelancer does. 'Try with your store' sits as an equal-weight button beside 'Quick start', with no hint that it fails until the plugin is installed.

C2.worst_defect: Refunds at the till are gated on 'the plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet', with no version, date or place to track it. 0.3.0 is dated 2026-10-06, so after six weeks an owner cannot tell whether it is days or months away. The at-the-till payment screenshot also shows a test product, 'Tally Fixture Mug'.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till … Not yet'; at-the-till 'Refund a sale'; at-the-till.desktop.02 screenshot

C3.worst_defect: Step 3 offers three ways to run the migration ('Run it with npx tsx …', 'Vendure's CLI alternative is npx vendure migrate', and the README / Plugin setup alternative), and the 9 steps mix tax-strategy and stock-strategy paragraphs and a LAN http rewrite into the main path. A freelancer has to choose and the owner can't check them. There is no short 'what your staff need on the counter' list (scanner, card terminal, printer, one tab per till).

C4.worst_defect: 'Close the day' / the Z report is a bullet list with only a whole-till shot whose cashier-sheet text is too small to read, so an owner can't see what the end-of-day figures look like. The changelog is pure developer notes ('order.create v5 custom lines … (ADR 0005)', 'Migration TallyPosV51790900000000') with no plain-language line on what changed for the shop.

C5.worst_defect: On desktop docs pages the grey sidebar panel stops at about y=900, after the theme toggle, and the page background changes below it, leaving a visible seam down the left column on every long page.

C6.worst_defect: Minor: on phone, quick-start step 6's tax table collapses header and value cells into one stacked column. It is readable but slower to scan than the desktop table. No overflow anywhere, and the on-page dropdown and code blocks wrap well.

C7.worst_defect: Minor: Lighthouse reports 52 KiB of unused JS on /, and /docs/quick-start has an LCP of 2.5 s (performance 97). Otherwise every check is clean: all 200s, 404 returns 404, no images without alt text, JSON-LD, llms.txt/llms-full.txt, sitemap, OG image.

overall_worst.defect: Refund at the till is promised for 'the plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet', with no version number, date or tracking link, repeated on several pages. A shop owner deciding whether staff can sell tomorrow cannot plan around a refund gap of unknown length.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till'; at-the-till 'Refund a sale' and 'Order details'; limitations; connect-a-till
overall_worst.fix: Name the release (for example '0.4.0') with an expected month or a link to its milestone. Say it once on Limitations with that date, and link to it from the home table and At the till. Add one line on what to do meanwhile (refund in the Vendure dashboard and the card terminal).
